AnimatedImageVector.name: AnimatedImageVector
AnimatedImageVector.jsdoc: AnimatedImageVector — public class, but its constructor and AnimatedVectorTarget are Kotlin-internal in animation-graphics 1.11.4 (verified via compiler metadata). Instances only come from XML resource parsing (loadAnimatedVectorResource(theme, resources, id) + rememberAnimatedVectorPainter), which needs Android Resources — not expressible in vesk JS; import fails closed by design.

foundation.name: Compose Foundation
foundation.description: Scroll, clickable, layout, gestures, lazy lists base.

Gson.name: Gson
Gson.jsdoc: JSON (de)serializer. Gson().toJson(obj) serializes; fromJson(json, type) parses.

JsonParser.name: JsonParser
JsonParser.jsdoc: Parses JSON text into a JsonElement tree. JsonParser().parse(text).

JsonObject.name: JsonObject
JsonObject.jsdoc: Mutable JSON object node. JsonObject().addProperty(key, value) / get(key).

JsonObject.name: JsonObject
JsonObject.jsdoc: Immutable JSON object. JsonObject({ key: value, ... }) builds from entries (values are JsonElement).

JsonArray.name: JsonArray
JsonArray.jsdoc: Immutable JSON array. JsonArray([ element, ... ]) builds from JsonElement values.

Moshi.name: Moshi
Moshi.jsdoc: Moshi JSON library. Moshi() / new Moshi.Builder().build() returns the JSON engine; Moshi.adapter(String) returns a JsonAdapter<String> (other adapters need class literals).

Builder.name: Builder
Builder.jsdoc: Moshi.Builder() — builder for a Moshi instance (public constructor, build() returns Moshi).

JsonAdapter.name: JsonAdapter
JsonAdapter.jsdoc: Typed JSON adapter base — abstract (subclasses generated by Moshi codegen); obtain via Moshi.adapter(type), never constructed directly.

OkHttpClient.name: OkHttpClient
OkHttpClient.jsdoc: HTTP client. Construct with OkHttpClient(); configure via OkHttpClient().newBuilder() before building requests.

retrofit.name: Retrofit
retrofit.description: Type-safe typed HTTP client for Android/JVM

Retrofit.name: Retrofit
Retrofit.jsdoc: Retrofit REST client. Retrofit.Builder().baseUrl(url).build() constructs the client; Retrofit.baseUrl() / callAdapterFactories() read it back.

Timber.name: Timber
Timber.jsdoc: Timber logging. Static surface: Timber.plant(Timber.DebugTree()), Timber.tag('x'), Timber.d/i/w/e('msg', ...), Timber.treeCount(). Writes to Android logcat.

DebugTree.name: DebugTree
DebugTree.jsdoc: Timber.DebugTree() — the debug tree to plant for logcat output.

QRCodeWriter.name: QRCodeWriter
QRCodeWriter.jsdoc: Encodes QR codes. QRCodeWriter().encode(content, format, width, height) returns a BitMatrix.

QRCodeReader.name: QRCodeReader
QRCodeReader.jsdoc: Decodes QR codes. QRCodeReader().decode(binaryBitmap) returns a Result.

BarcodeFormat.name: BarcodeFormat
BarcodeFormat.jsdoc: Barcode/QR format enum. Pass BarcodeFormat.QR_CODE to QRCodeWriter().encode().
